gate_shape.reading: the doctrine gate is non-compensatory over 13 axes; this engine is compensatory over 4. the compensation-error count is the measured cost of that mismatch on the published eval split

no_winner_clause: this bench names no winner and no baseline is beaten. it reports properties of one engine against one labelled corpus, and every number carries the receipt it came from
what_is_not_benchmarked: no public adversarial benchmark has been run
no comparison against any other system
